title: Zero to $5K MRR: A 90-Day Solopreneur SaaS Launch Plan
excerpt: A phased blueprint for building a micro-SaaS as a solopreneur. Covers validation, MVP build, pricing, and growth tactics with real revenue milestones.
content:
## Why Micro-SaaS in 2026

Micro-SaaS has a median time-to-first-dollar of 47 days, according to TinySaaS's 2025 report. The average successful micro-SaaS generates $5,200 MRR by month 12 with 68% gross margin. No-code builders reach $1K MRR only 12 days slower than developers but spend 82% less.

## Phase 1: Validate in 7 Days

68% of failed SaaS projects built a full product before talking to 20+ potential customers. Instead, write a landing page with pricing, drive 200 visitors via LinkedIn, and measure how many click buy. If 5% click the CTA and 30% leave their email, your idea has demand.

Use Ahrefs to validate keyword demand: target keywords with 500-2,000 monthly searches and low competition. Validated ideas have a 91% success rate reaching $2K MRR.

## Phase 2: MVP in 21 Days for Under $500

MVPs with 3-5 core features have 2.4x higher conversion rates. Build: authentication, core feature, Stripe checkout, customer dashboard. Stack: Bubble ($32/month), Supabase (free), Stripe (2.9%+$0.30), custom domain ($10/year).

Set a hard 21-day deadline. Micro-SaaS projects with published launch dates ship 4.1x faster than open-ended builds.

## Phase 3: Pricing and First 50 Customers

A $10/month increase raises LTV by $7.20/month with only 2-3% conversion drop. Optimal pricing: $19-$29/month. Acquire first 50 customers via LinkedIn direct outreach, converting at 8-12%. Supplement with 5 SEO articles targeting long-tail keywords.

## Phase 4: Retention Systems

Median monthly churn is 7.4% in months 1-6. At $5K MRR, that means losing $370 monthly. Implement at-risk detection: flag customers inactive for 7 days and send a personalized email. This reduces churn to 2.8%. Customers who see their feature requests built stay 4.2x longer.

## The Micro-SaaS Advantage

Micro-SaaS targets one specific pain point for one customer segment. The median time-to-first-dollar is just 47 days. With no-code tools like Bubble, Supabase, and Stripe, you can build and launch for under $500. Those reaching the 5% validation threshold have a 91% success rate at $2K MRR.

## MVP Development Strategy

Build only what is essential: authentication, core feature, checkout, and dashboard. Skip onboarding emails, analytics, and admin panels which add 60% to build time but deliver less than 5% of initial value. Set a hard 21-day deadline.

## Customer Acquisition

Your first 50 customers come from direct outreach, not paid advertising. Personalized LinkedIn messages offering a 30-day free trial convert at 8-12%. Supplement with 5 SEO articles targeting long-tail keywords. A ConvertKit onboarding sequence reduces first-month churn from 18% to 7%.
